comment: The hardware manual cascades the four trigger outputs clockwise, so that the bottom right jack carries LFOs 2, 4 and 6 and the bottom left carries all four; the plugin's own names put LFO 8 at the bottom right and LFO 6 at the bottom left. The lines follow the plugin. The manual's cascading normalisation, where an unpatched trigger jack layers into the next, could not be confirmed in the plugin and is left out. The hardware manual puts the expander to the right of øchd, and øchd's own Add expander item places it there, but Ochd::onExpanderChange and OchdExpander::process both test the neighbour on each side, so it works on either.
